label: biporate
definition: A structural quality inhering in a pollen grain by virtue of its having two circular apertures (pores).
reason: This is a real pollen aperture type with no PATO term. The new class sits beside FLOPO:0991361 trisyncolpate under the same parent, and only pollen bears it.
Thick means increased thickness. 'Very' is a degree word that stays in the record.

A stem that roots at the nodes has roots growing from the shoot (PO synonym adventitious root). FLOPO:0991009 creeping adds a prostrate habit, which these statements do not say. 'Not rooting nodally' is the negated statement.
The definition of FLOPO reticulate already covers being marked by a network of veins (synonym net-veined).
This is a compound of two shape values, handled like linear-lanceolate. Neither value needs a new term.

word: ratio of main sinus/middle segment length
reason: This is a ratio between a measure of the leaf sinus (PO_0025384) and the length of the middle segment. A ratio stays in the RDF record and is not a term.
This is the length-to-width ratio of the leaf blade, a ratio of two dimensions of one part.
This is a comparison stated without its second term, like 'shorter' and 'smaller' in the previous review. Complete phrases ('longer than the culm') go to docs/odp/09.
The word describes a triangular cross-section, and triquetrous is already a related synonym of trigonous. The 'ob-' reversal of the angles is too rare and unclear to justify its own term.
'Semi-' marks an approximate degree of pendent, like the '±' and 'sub-' values.
Cloudy latex is latex that is not clear, which is PATO opaque (synonym non-transparent). Restrict the rule to latex and exudates.
This is a similarity to another named part (scape bracts). It needs the relation pattern, not a term.

label: anthocyanic
definition: A color quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being tinged red, purple or bluish by anthocyanin pigments.
reason: Floras use it as a standard colour term covering a range of hues that no single PATO colour matches. Its parent is the same as FLOPO:0991363 sordid.

The statement measures the internodes. The bearer is the stem internode and the quality is length, measured as in the range patterns.
